description: Parametric curved-blade generator (scimitar family) at HAND-WEAPON scale: swept diamond profile along an arc, tapered to a true point, quillon crossguard, co-authored UVs + EditableImage texture
name: procedural-swept-blade
body:
Claude-authored generator - adapt parameters or sweep path for new families (horns, tusks, curved staffs). FIRST: pull real reference proportions for the target weapon (web/exemplars) and list its signature features; judge captures against THAT list, not memory.
1. Generic tube(stations) skinner: stations {cf, halfWidth, halfThick, u}; 4 corners spine(-X) v=0, +Z v=.25, edge(+X, convex) v=.5, -Z v=.75, wrap v=1; quad ring pairs + base-cap fan + apex fan. Multiple tubes can share one EditableMesh.
2. Main tube: hooked pommel (station offset +0.06 X, w .115) -> grip along +Y (len ~0.85, w .085) -> collar (w .115) -> blade arc: R=4.7, 35deg, 22 segs, cf = top * CFrame.new(cos(a)*R-R, sin(a)*R, 0) * Angles(0,0,a); width 0.17 base, yelman flare to 0.20 at s=0.85, taper to a POINT (apex vertex +0.07 local Y); halfThick 0.035*(1-s)+0.006.
3. Quillon crossguard = second tube along +/-X at guard height (stations rotated Angles(0,0,-90deg)): tips 0.02 -> bulb 0.065 at center, span +/-0.34, all UVs u=0.24 (brass band).
4. u = length fraction (handle 0-0.22, guard 0.26, blade->0.98). CreateMeshPartAsync.
5. SCALE GATE: part.Size vs the 5-stud character - hand weapons ~2.5-4 studs, thin axis under ~0.3.
6. Texture: EditableImage 512x128; CLAMP every DrawRectangle (w=min(w,W-x)). Subtle: steel base + soft edge halo rows 54-74 + bright core, spine shade rows 0-10/118-128, faint 2px streaks; leather grip + wrap bands, brass pommel/guard. part.TextureContent = Content.fromObject(img).
Verified 2026-07-03 vs kilij/shamshir references: 272 tris, size 1.26 x 3.73 x 0.20.
